title: ЭЕШ English mock 2018 · Mock 2
subject: English
theme: City life, environment and a young café owner
status: Original practice content written by Claude Code (Opus 5.5) on 2026-11-06 to mirror the official paper's structure, task types, timing and level. Not copied from БҮТ papers. Teacher review pending. Not used on the website.

tasks.title: Grammar
tasks.instructions: Read the following sentences. Choose the correct answer for each gap. /12 x 1 = 12 points/

questions.stem: My cousin is ___ engineer at ___ factory near Darkhan.
questions.explanation: Мэргэжлийг “an engineer” гэж тодорхойгүй артикльтай хэлдэг бөгөөд “engineer” эгшиг авиагаар эхэлдэг тул “an”; үйлдвэр анх дурдагдаж, “factory” гийгүүлэгчээр эхэлсэн тул “a” орж “an / a” болно.

questions.stem: We usually go skiing ___ the mountains ___ January.
questions.explanation: Уулын бүсэд байхыг “in the mountains”, сарыг “in January” гэж хоёуланд нь “in” угтвар үгээр илэрхийлдэг тул “in / in”; “on” нь өдөр, гарагийн өмнө ордог.

questions.stem: The test was so easy that I ___ needed any time to finish it.
questions.explanation: “so easy that” (маш амархан байсан тул) гэдгээс бараг цаг шаардаагүй нь харагдана; “hardly” (бараг …-гүй) нь үгүйсгэх утгатай дайвар үг бөгөөд “hard” (шаргуу, хэцүү) гэдгээс тэс өөр.

questions.stem: There ___ two new students in our class, and they ___ very well.
questions.explanation: “two new students” олон тоо тул “There are”; тэд одоогийн байдлаар сайн сурч байгаа тул “they” өгүүлэгдэхүүнтэй одоо үргэлжилж буй цаг “are doing” орно.

questions.stem: I'm afraid I can't play in the match tomorrow. I ___ my leg.
questions.explanation: “I can't play in the match tomorrow” гэдэг нь өнгөрсөнд хөлөө хугалсны одоогийн үр дагавар; үр дүн нь одоо мэдрэгдэж буй ийм үйлийг одоо төгссөн цаг “have broken” илэрхийлнэ.

questions.stem: When the phone ___, I ___ a shower.
questions.explanation: Шүршүүрт орох нь үргэлжилж байсан урт үйл тул өнгөрсөн үргэлжилсэн цаг “was having”, утас дуугарсан нь түүнийг тасалсан богино үйл тул өнгөрсөн энгийн цаг “rang” орно.

questions.stem: You haven't seen my glasses, ___?
questions.explanation: Өгүүлбэр “haven't seen” гэж үгүйсгэлтэй тул хавсралт асуулт эерэг байх бөгөөд ижил туслах үйл үг “have” давтагдана: “have you”.

questions.stem: This time next week we ___ on a beach in Thailand.
questions.explanation: “This time next week” нь ирээдүйн тодорхой агшинд үргэлжилж байх үйлийг заадаг тул ирээдүйн үргэлжилсэн цаг “will be lying” (далайн эрэг дээр хэвтэж байх болно) хэрэглэнэ.

questions.stem: If I ___ you, I ___ that old car.
questions.explanation: Зөвлөгөө өгөх “If I were you” хэллэгт бүх биед “were” хэрэглэдэг бөгөөд энэ нь 2-р төрлийн нөхцөлт өгүүлбэр тул гол хэсэгт “would” орж “wouldn't buy” болно.

questions.stem:
Teacher: Where ___ these photos taken?
Student: My father ___ them in the Gobi last summer.
questions.explanation: Асуултад “these photos” олон тоо бөгөөд зургийг хэн нэгэн авсан тул үйлдэгдэх хэвийн “were … taken”; хариултад “My father” өөрөө авсан тул үйлдэх хэвийн “took” орж “were / took” болно.

questions.stem: She was wearing a ___ dress.
questions.explanation: Тэмдэг нэрийн дараалал: үнэлгээ (“beautiful”) → хэмжээ, урт (“long”) → өнгө (“blue”) → материал (“cotton”); иймд “beautiful, long, blue, cotton”.

questions.stem: I didn't go to school yesterday ___ I had a bad cold.
questions.explanation: “I had a bad cold” гэсэн бүтэн өгүүлбэр сургуульд яваагүй шалтгааныг заах тул “because” орно; харин “because of” нь зөвхөн нэр үгийн өмнө ордог (“because of a bad cold”).

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.instructions: Read the sentences and choose the correct word for each blank. /10 x 2 = 20 points/

questions.stem: Batbold always shares his food and money with others. He is very ___.
questions.explanation: Хоол, мөнгөө бусадтай хуваалцдаг (“shares his food and money with others”) хүнийг “generous” (өгөөмөр) гэнэ; “selfish” (хувиа хичээсэн) нь эсрэг утгатай.

questions.stem: It is ___ to wear a seat belt in a car; it's the law.
questions.explanation: “it's the law” (энэ бол хууль) гэсэн тул хамгаалах бүс зүүх нь заавал биелүүлэх ёстой буюу “compulsory” (албадлагатай, заавал); “optional” (сайн дурын) нь эсрэг утгатай.

questions.stem: His handwriting is so bad that it's completely ___.
questions.explanation: Гар бичмэл нь маш муу (“His handwriting is so bad”) тул уншиж болохооргүй буюу “illegible” (уншигдахгүй); “illegal” нь хууль бус гэсэн огт өөр утгатай.

questions.stem: Swimming is a good ___ exercise that works almost every muscle in the body.
questions.explanation: “works almost every muscle in the body” (биеийн бараг бүх булчинг ажиллуулдаг) гэсэн нь бие махбодын буюу “physical” дасгал болохыг заана; “mental” нь оюуны, “social” нь нийгмийн.

questions.stem: Every four years, citizens vote in the presidential ___.
questions.explanation: “citizens vote” (иргэд санал өгдөг) гэсэн үйл явцыг “election” (сонгууль) гэнэ: “presidential election” нь ерөнхийлөгчийн сонгууль; “selection” нь сонгон шалгаруулалт.

questions.stem: Can you look ___ my cat while I'm on holiday?
questions.explanation: “look after” хэлц үйл үг нь асран халамжлах гэсэн утгатай; амралтаар явах хооронд (“while I'm on holiday”) муурыг харж хандахыг хүсэж байна, харин “look for” нь хайх.

questions.stem: The plane took ___ on time despite the snow.
questions.explanation: “take off” хэлц үйл үг онгоцны тухайд газраас хөөрөх гэсэн утгатай; “despite the snow” (цас орсон ч) онгоц цагтаа хөөрсөн.

questions.stem: Could you get me a ___ of jam and a ___ of tuna from the shop?
questions.explanation: Чанамлыг шилэн саваар (“a jar of jam”), туна загасыг лаазаар (“a tin of tuna”) худалдаж авдаг тул “jar / tin” гэж нөхнө.

questions.stem: Air ___ in Ulaanbaatar is worst in winter, when many families burn coal.
questions.explanation: Айлууд нүүрс түлдэг (“many families burn coal”) өвлийн улиралд агаар бохирддог тул “Air pollution” (агаарын бохирдол); “population” нь хүн ам гэсэн утгатай.

questions.stem: The company decided to ___ ten new workers this year.
questions.explanation: “ten new workers” (шинэ арван ажилтан) гэсэн нь компани хүн нэмж авахыг илтгэх тул “employ” (ажилд авах); “fire” нь ажлаас халах, “retire”, “resign” нь ажилтан өөрөө ажлаас гарах.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.instructions: Choose the correct word to complete the conversations. /3 x 2 = 6 points/

questions.stem:
Oyuka: How was the horror film?
Temuulen: Terrible! I was so ___ that I couldn't sleep.
questions.explanation: “horror film” үзээд “I couldn't sleep” (унтаж чадаагүй) гэсэн тул “frightened” (айсан); “amused” (хөгжилтэй), “relaxed” (тайван) нь утгаараа зөрчилдөнө.

questions.stem:
Patient: I've had a headache for three days.
Doctor: Take this ___ to the pharmacy and they will give you some tablets.
questions.explanation: Эмч “Take this … to the pharmacy” гэж эмийн санд өгөх бичиг өгч байгаа тул “prescription” (эмийн жор); “recipe” нь хоолны жор, “receipt” нь төлбөрийн баримт.

questions.stem:
Dad: The river is very high after all this rain.
Mom: Yes, if it keeps raining, there'll be a ___.
questions.explanation: “The river is very high after all this rain” гэдгээс бороо үргэлжилбэл гол халин үерлэх нь тодорхой тул “flood” (үер); “drought” нь ган, “blizzard” нь цасан шуурга.

tasks.title: Task 3
tasks.instructions: Choose the correct prefix to build the antonym of the adjectives. /2 x 2 = 4 points/

questions.explanation: “l” үсгээр эхэлсэн тэмдэг нэрийн эсрэг утгатай үгийг “il-” угтвараар үүсгэдэг: “legal” (хууль ёсны) → “illegal” (хууль бус).

questions.stem: ________ --- comfortable
questions.explanation: “comfortable” (тухтай) гэдгийн эсрэг утгатай үг нь “un-” угтвартай “uncomfortable” (тухгүй, эвгүй); “dis-”, “in-” угтвар энэ үгтэй хэрэглэгддэггүй.

tasks.title: Conversation 1
tasks.instructions: Read the conversations and choose the best answers for them. There are 2 blanks in the conversation (28-29). Fill in the blanks from the given options. /5 x 2 = 10 points/
tasks.text:
Librarian: Good morning. Can I help you?
Zaya: Yes, I'd like to borrow these three books, please.
Librarian: Of course. 28. _________
Zaya: Oh no, I think I left it at home. Is that a problem?
Librarian: I'm afraid you need it to take books out. But you can read them here in the reading room until we close.
Zaya: OK. What time do you close today?
Librarian: 29. _________
Zaya: Great, that gives me plenty of time. Thank you.

options.D: Can I see your library card, please?

questions.explanation: Заяа “I think I left it at home” гэж хариулж, номын санч “you need it to take books out” гэж нэмсэн тул ном зээлэхэд хэрэгтэй картыг “Can I see your library card, please?” гэж асуусан байна.

options.C: Not until eight o'clock this evening.

questions.explanation: Заяа “that gives me plenty of time” (надад хангалттай цаг байна) гэсэн тул номын сан оройтож хаадаг гэсэн хариулт хэрэгтэй: “Not until eight o'clock this evening.” (өнөө орой найман цаг хүртэл хаахгүй).

questions.stem: Where is the conversation taking place?
questions.explanation: “I'd like to borrow these three books”, “the reading room” гэсэн хэллэгээс яриа “In a library” болж байгаа нь тодорхой; номын дэлгүүрт ном зээлдэггүй.

tasks.title: Conversation 2
tasks.text:
Mr. Ganbaatar: I've just read the news. The city is going to build a new park where the old car park is.
Mrs. Ganbaatar: Really? That's fantastic news! The children will finally have somewhere safe to play.
Mr. Ganbaatar: I'm not so sure. They said it will take five years, and they always promise things and never finish them.
Mrs. Ganbaatar: Don't be so negative. This time the money has already been approved.
Mr. Ganbaatar: Well, I'll believe it when I see it.

questions.stem: Mrs. Ganbaatar is ___ about the news.
questions.explanation: Хатагтай Ганбаатар “That's fantastic news!” гэж хүүхдүүд аюулгүй тоглох газартай болно гэдэгт баярласан тул “pleased” (баярласан, сэтгэл хангалуун).

questions.stem: Mr. Ganbaatar is ___ about the new park.
questions.explanation: Ноён Ганбаатар “I'll believe it when I see it” (нүдээрээ харвал л итгэнэ) гэсэн нь парк баригдана гэдэгт эргэлзэж буйг буюу “sceptical” (эргэлзсэн, итгэлгүй) байгааг илтгэнэ.

tasks.title: Passage 1
tasks.instructions: Read the passage and choose the correct answers. /4 x 2 = 8 points/
tasks.text:
In many European cities, the bicycle has become one of the most popular ways to get to work. In Copenhagen, for example, almost half of all trips to work or school are made by bike. This was not always the case. In the 1970s, the city's streets were full of cars, and cycling was seen as slow and dangerous.

Things began to change when oil prices rose sharply and many people could no longer afford to drive every day. The city government built separate lanes for cyclists and special traffic lights for **them**. Over the following decades, it invested more and more in cycling, and people slowly changed their habits.

Today, cycling is not only cheap but also healthy and good for the environment. Studies show that people who cycle regularly take fewer sick days, and the city has much cleaner air than before. Other cities around the world are now trying to <u>imitate</u> Copenhagen's success.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?

options.A: It is about how oil prices rose in the 1970s.
options.B: It is about the dangers of cycling in traffic.
options.C: It is about how one city made cycling a popular way to travel.
options.D: It is about why cars are faster than bicycles.
options.E: It is about the health problems of people in Europe.

questions.explanation: Эх бүхэлдээ Копенгаген хот дугуйн тусгай зам барьж, олон арван жил хөрөнгө оруулсны үр дүнд “almost half of all trips to work or school are made by bike” болсныг өгүүлнэ.

questions.stem: Many people in Copenhagen started cycling because ___

options.A: cars were banned from the city.
options.D: driving became too expensive for them.
options.E: they wanted to take fewer sick days.

questions.explanation: 2-р догол мөрөнд “oil prices rose sharply and many people could no longer afford to drive every day” гэсэн нь машин унах нь хэтэрхий үнэтэй болсныг харуулна.

questions.stem: The pronoun "them" in bold in paragraph 2 refers to ___.
questions.explanation: “The city government built separate lanes for cyclists and special traffic lights for them” өгүүлбэрт тусгай гэрлэн дохиог дугуйчдад зориулсан тул “them” нь “cyclists” буюу дугуйчдыг заана.

questions.stem: The word "imitate" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to ___.
questions.explanation: “Other cities … are now trying to imitate Copenhagen's success” гэдэгт “imitate” нь бусдын амжилтыг дуурайх, хуулбарлах гэсэн утгатай тул “copy”.

tasks.title: Passage 2
tasks.instructions: Read the text and choose the correct answers. There are 3 blanks in the text (37-39). Fill in the blanks from the given options. /4 x 2 = 8 points/
tasks.text:
Hi Mark,

Thanks for your last message. Sorry I didn't write sooner. I 37. _________ really busy with exams for the past two weeks. Good news: they're finally over, and I think I did quite well!

Now I'm planning my summer. My parents want me to get a part-time job, so I've applied to work at a café in the city centre. I have an interview 38. _________ Thursday morning, so wish me luck!

In July, my family is going to visit my grandparents in the countryside. 39. _________ we went there last year, I learned to ride a horse, and this year my grandfather has promised to teach me how to make airag.

Why don't you come and visit us in August? You could stay at our place, and I could show you around Ulaanbaatar.

Write back soon,
Temuujin

questions.explanation: “for the past two weeks” (сүүлийн хоёр долоо хоногийн турш) нь өнгөрсөнд эхэлж одоо хүртэлх хугацааг заах тул одоо төгссөн цаг “have been” хэрэглэнэ.
Гарагийн нэрийн өмнө “on” угтвар үг ордог бөгөөд тодорхой гарагийн өглөө (“Thursday morning”) ч мөн “on” авна; “in the morning” гэвэл гарагийн нэргүй байна.
Тэнд очих үед (“we went there last year”) морь унаж сурсан тул цаг хугацааг заах холбоос үг “When” тохирно; “Because of” нь нэр үгийн өмнө, “Although” нь эсрэгцүүлэл заана.

questions.stem: Temuujin is writing to ___.

options.A: tell Mark his news and invite him to visit
options.C: apply for a job at a café
options.D: ask Mark to teach him to ride a horse
options.E: say he cannot see Mark this summer

questions.explanation: Тэмүүжин шалгалт, зуны төлөвлөгөөгөө хуваалцаад “Why don't you come and visit us in August?” гэж урьсан тул захидлын зорилго нь мэдээгээ хэлж, Маркийг урих.

tasks.instructions: Read the questions (a-e) and complete them with the appropriate words (1-7). /5 x 1 = 5 points/ (5 min)

items.label: a
items.text: What ___ you doing at 8 o'clock last night?
items.explanation: “at 8 o'clock last night” нь өнгөрсөн тодорхой агшинд үргэлжилж байсан үйлийг асууж байгаа тул өнгөрсөн үргэлжилсэн цаг: “What were you doing …?”

items.label: b
items.text: How often ___ your brother go to the gym these days?
items.explanation: “these days” (сүүлийн үед) гэсэн давтамжийн асуултад одоо энгийн цаг хэрэглэх бөгөөд “your brother” 3-р биеийн ганц тоо тул “does” орно.

items.label: c
items.text: How long ___ she worked at the hospital? Since 2019?
items.explanation: “Since 2019?” гэсэн тодруулга нь одоо хүртэл үргэлжилж буй ажлыг заах тул одоо төгссөн цаг хэрэгтэй; “she” 3-р биеийн ганц тоо тул “has … worked”.

items.label: d
items.text: Who ___ win the match tomorrow, do you think?
items.explanation: “tomorrow” ирээдүйг заах ба “do you think?” гэж таамаг асууж байгаа тул ирээдүй энгийн цагийн “will” орно: “Who will win the match tomorrow?”

items.label: e
items.text: Where ___ you go on holiday last summer?
items.explanation: “last summer” өнгөрсөн цагийг заадаг тул асуултад туслах үйл үг “did” орж, үндсэн үйл үг “go” үндсэн хэлбэрээрээ үлдэнэ.

tasks.instructions: Read the incomplete sentences (a-e) and fill in the gaps with the appropriate words (1-7). /5 x 1 = 5 points/ (5 min)

items.label: a
items.text: Could you ___ me your pen for a minute?
items.explanation: Өөрийнхөө юмыг бусдад түр өгөхийг “lend” гэнэ: “Could you … me your pen” нь үзгээ надад түр өгөөч гэсэн хүсэлт; “borrow” нь бусдаас түр авах.

items.label: b
items.text: The students left ___ bags in the classroom.
items.explanation: “bags” нэр үгийн өмнө хэний цүнх болохыг заах эзэмшлийн төлөөний үг “their” (тэдний) орно; “there” нь тэнд, “they're” нь “they are” гэсэн товчлол.

items.label: c
items.text: ___ going to the cinema tonight. Do you want to join them?
items.explanation: Өгүүлбэрт өгүүлэгдэхүүн, туслах үйл үг хоёулаа дутуу тул “they are” гэдгийн товчилсон хэлбэр “they're” орно: “… going to the cinema tonight”.

items.label: d
items.text: ___ coat is this? It was on the floor.
items.explanation: “… coat is this?” гэж цув хэнийх болохыг асууж байгаа тул эзэмшил заах “whose”; “who's” нь “who is” гэсэн товчлол тул энд тохирохгүй.

items.label: e
items.text: Can I ___ your dictionary until tomorrow?
items.explanation: “Can I … your dictionary” гэж бусдын юмыг түр авах зөвшөөрөл хүсэж байгаа тул “borrow” (зээлж авах); “until tomorrow” нь маргааш буцааж өгнө гэсэн утгатай.

tasks.instructions: Match the beginnings of the sentences (a-e) with the appropriate endings (1-7). /5 x 1 = 5 points/ (5 min)

items.label: a
items.text: We missed the bus …
items.explanation: Автобуснаас хоцорсны шалтгааныг “because” хэсэг тайлбарлана: “We missed the bus … because we got up too late.” (хэт оройтож боссон учраас).

items.label: b
items.text: If it rains tomorrow, …
items.explanation: “If it rains tomorrow” гэсэн одоо энгийн цагтай нөхцөлд ирээдүй энгийн цагтай үр дүн тохирно (1-р төрлийн нөхцөлт өгүүлбэр): “… we will cancel the picnic.”; “would have cancelled” нь 3-р төрлийнх.

items.label: c
items.text: My sister, who lives in Seoul, …
items.explanation: Таслалаар тусгаарласан “who lives in Seoul” тодотгол өгүүлбэрийн дараа “My sister” өгүүлэгдэхүүний үйл үг дутуу байгаа тул “… is coming to visit us next month.” орно.

items.label: d
items.text: I have known Bat …
items.explanation: “have known” (одоо төгссөн цаг) нь хэзээнээс хойш танилцсаныг “since” үгээр заана: “I have known Bat … since we were at primary school together.”

items.label: e
items.text: The museum was so interesting …
items.explanation: “so” + тэмдэг нэр + “that” бүтэц үр дүнг илэрхийлдэг: музей маш сонирхолтой байсан тул “… that we stayed there all afternoon.” (үдээс хойш бүхэлдээ тэнд байсан).

choices.text: … that we stayed there all afternoon.
… because we got up too late.
… since we were at primary school together.
… is coming to visit us next month.
… we would have cancelled the picnic.

tasks.instructions: Match the places (a-e) with what people do there (1-7). /5 x 1 = 5 points/ (5 min)

items.label: a
items.text: A gym …
items.explanation: Фитнесс заал буюу “gym”-д хүмүүс дасгал хийж, жин өргөдөг: “… is where people exercise and lift weights.”

items.label: b
items.text: A pharmacy …
items.explanation: “pharmacy” (эмийн сан) бол эм худалдаж авдаг газар тул “… is where people buy medicine.”; тэнд ажилладаг хүнийг “pharmacist” гэдэг.

items.label: c
items.text: A museum …
items.explanation: Музейд (“museum”) эртний, үнэ цэнэтэй эд зүйлсийг дэлгэн үзүүлдэг тул “… is where people see old and valuable objects.”

items.label: d
items.text: A post office …
items.explanation: “post office” буюу шуудангийн салбарт хүмүүс захидал, илгээмж явуулдаг тул “… is where people send letters and parcels.”

items.label: e
items.text: A stadium …
items.explanation: Цэнгэлдэх хүрээлэн (“stadium”) бол олон мянган үзэгч спортын тэмцээн, тоглолт үздэг газар: “… is where people watch sports matches and concerts.”

choices.text: … is where people send letters and parcels.
… is where people watch sports matches and concerts.
… is where people exercise and lift weights.
… is where people see old and valuable objects.
… is where people get their hair cut.

tasks.title: Listening
tasks.instructions: You are going to listen to a radio presenter interviewing a young café owner. Read each question and choose the correct answer. You have 1 minute and 30 seconds to look through the questions before you listen. You will listen to the passage twice only, so listen carefully. /6 x 2 = 12 points/
tasks.audioScript:
Presenter: Welcome back to 'Young Talents'. My guest today is a nineteen-year-old who has just opened her own café. Welcome!
Guest: Thank you for inviting me.
Presenter: Can you tell our listeners your name?
Guest: Sure. I'm Khulan Batsaikhan. Khulan is spelt K-H-U-L-A-N.
Presenter: Khulan, when did you first become interested in cooking?
Guest: When I was about eleven. My grandmother ran a small restaurant, and I helped her every weekend.
Presenter: And now you have your own café. That's amazing at nineteen!
Guest: Well, I didn't do it alone. My older brother manages the money, and two friends from college work with me.
Presenter: What's special about your café?
Guest: We use only local ingredients: milk, meat and berries from Mongolian farms. And every dish on the menu is under ten thousand tugriks, because I want students to be able to eat there.
Presenter: Is it busy?
Guest: Very! At lunchtime there's usually a queue outside. In the evenings it's quieter, so I'm thinking of starting cooking classes then.
Presenter: Great idea. What do you do to relax?
Guest: Honestly, I don't have much free time, but I go hiking with my dog on Sundays, and I love reading cookbooks, which is still work, I suppose!
Presenter: Khulan, thank you so much.

questions.stem: Why is Khulan on the programme?

options.A: She has won a cooking competition.
options.C: She is a famous food writer.
options.D: She teaches cooking at a college.
options.E: She has opened her own café at a young age.

questions.explanation: Хөтлөгч зочноо “a nineteen-year-old who has just opened her own café” гэж танилцуулсан тул Хулан залуухан насандаа өөрийн кафе нээсэн учраас нэвтрүүлэгт оролцож байна.

questions.stem: How is the guest's first name spelt?
questions.explanation: Зочин “Khulan is spelt K-H-U-L-A-N” гэж үсэглэсэн тул “KHULAN”; “HULAN”, “KULAN” зэрэгт нэг үсэг дутуу, “KHULANN”-д илүү үсэг бий.

questions.stem: As a child, Khulan helped her grandmother ___.
questions.explanation: Хулан “My grandmother ran a small restaurant, and I helped her every weekend” гэсэн тул бага байхдаа амралтын өдөр бүр эмээдээ тусалдаг байжээ.

questions.stem: Why is every dish under ten thousand tugriks?

options.A: She wants students to be able to afford them.
options.B: Her brother told her to do it.

questions.explanation: Хулан “every dish on the menu is under ten thousand tugriks, because I want students to be able to eat there” гэж оюутнуудад үнэ нь хүрэхүйц байлгахыг хүссэнээ тайлбарласан.

questions.stem: What is Khulan thinking of doing?

options.B: Starting cooking classes in the evenings.

questions.explanation: “In the evenings it's quieter, so I'm thinking of starting cooking classes then” гэсэн тул Хулан орой хоол хийх сургалт эхлүүлэхээр бодож байна.

questions.stem: Khulan mentions all of the following EXCEPT ___.
questions.explanation: Хулан нохойтойгоо явган аялах, хоолны ном унших, нутгийн жимс хэрэглэх, ах нь мөнгө хариуцдаг тухай ярьсан ч “playing the guitar” буюу гитар тоглох тухай дурдаагүй.
